title: 协商交付日期
subtitle_en: Can we split the delivery into two parts?
goal_text: 跟客户谈下一个双方都认的交付日期，不当场答应做不到的事。
brief_cn: 被人临时压期是最容易开口就输的场面。这一课练三步：问清到底要哪天；老实说做不到，并说清为什么；给出分阶段交付的方案，最后把两个日期钉下来。

vocab.example_en: The new deadline is very tight.
What we can do is deliver the first part.
When exactly do you need it?
To be honest, that won't work.
Can we split the delivery into two parts?
The current scope needs more time.
Your team promised a faster delivery.
So we agree on both dates?

briefing.cn_prompt: 跟我读这句，先把日期问死。
briefing.ref_text: When exactly do you need it?
briefing.translation_cn: 你们到底需要哪天交付？
briefing.accept_notes: 说出 exactly 和 need it，句子完整即通过。

briefing.cn_prompt: 跟我读这句，客气但明确地说不行。
briefing.ref_text: To be honest, that won't work.
briefing.translation_cn: 说实话，这个日期做不到。
briefing.accept_notes: 说出 honest 和 won't work，语气自然即通过。

briefing.cn_prompt: 听一遍，用自己的话说出你的拆分方案。
briefing.ref_text: We can deliver the first part on Monday. The full report needs two more weeks. Can we split the delivery?
briefing.translation_cn: 我们可以在周一交付第一部分。完整报告还需要两周。我们可以拆分交付吗？
briefing.reference_answer: Deliver first part Monday; full report needs two more weeks; split delivery.
briefing.accept_notes: 说出周一交第一部分、完整报告需两周、提出拆分即通过。

briefing.ref_text: 如果你们再给我两周，我可以完成全部内容。
briefing.reference_answer: If you give me two more weeks, I can finish everything.
briefing.accept_notes: 说出 two more weeks 和 finish everything 即通过。

briefing.ref_text: 我们可以把交付分成两个部分吗？
briefing.reference_answer: Can we split the delivery into two parts?
briefing.accept_notes: 说出 split 和 two parts 即通过。

briefing.cn_prompt: 用 deadline 说一句：新期限太紧。
briefing.reference_answer: The new deadline is very tight.
briefing.accept_notes: 说出 deadline，并表达时间紧即通过。

mission.persona_cn: 客户方的项目对接人（甲方），只认会议时间
mission.user_role_cn: 乙方项目负责人，你要保住质量也要守信用
mission.context_cn: 你的咨询项目还剩两周工作量，客户周一早上突然说大老板要提前看东西。客户会反复把话题拉回“周一能不能全交”，你必须给出具体的拆分方案和两个日期。
mission.opening_a: We need the project earlier. Can you deliver everything next Monday?
mission.opening_a_cn: 我们需要提前拿到项目。你们下周一能全部交付吗？

exchanges.a: We need the project earlier. Can you deliver everything next Monday?
exchanges.b: When exactly do you need it?
exchanges.a_cn: 我们需要提前拿到项目。你们下周一能全部交付吗？
exchanges.b_cn: 你们到底需要哪天交付？

exchanges.a: Monday morning is best. We have a big meeting at two.
exchanges.b: To be honest, that won't work.
exchanges.a_cn: 周一上午最好。我们两点有个重要会议。
exchanges.b_cn: 说实话，这个日期做不到。

exchanges.a: Why not? Your team promised a fast delivery.
exchanges.b: To be honest, the current scope needs more time.
exchanges.a_cn: 为什么不行？你们团队说过可以很快交付。
exchanges.b_cn: 说实话，现在这个范围需要更多时间。

exchanges.a: I can't wait two weeks. What can you do by Monday?
exchanges.b: What we can do is deliver the first part.
exchanges.a_cn: 我等不了两周。周一你们能先交什么？

exchanges.a: Which part can you finish first?
exchanges.b: We can finish the summary and slides.
exchanges.b_cn: 我们可以完成摘要和幻灯片。

exchanges.a: That helps, but I still need the full report.
exchanges.b: If you give me two more weeks, I can finish everything.
exchanges.a_cn: 这有帮助，但我还是需要完整报告。
exchanges.b_cn: 如果再给我两周，我可以完成全部内容。

exchanges.a: Two weeks is late for us. So what can we do?
exchanges.b: Can we split the delivery into two parts?
exchanges.a_cn: 两周对我们太晚了。那能怎么办？
exchanges.b_cn: 我们能把交付拆成两部分吗？

exchanges.b: One part on Monday, the full report in two weeks.
exchanges.b_cn: 一部分周一交，完整报告两周后。

exchanges.a: Fine. First part on Monday, full report in two weeks.
exchanges.b: So we agree on both dates?
exchanges.a_cn: 行。第一部分周一，完整报告两周后。
exchanges.b_cn: 那这两个日期就算定下来了？

tasks.desc_cn: 询问客户具体需要哪天交付
tasks.hint_en: When exactly do you need it?
tasks.hint_cn: 别急着答应，先问 When exactly。

tasks.desc_cn: 说明目前范围无法周一完成
tasks.hint_en: To be honest, that won't work.
tasks.hint_cn: To be honest 开头，拒绝就不生硬。

tasks.desc_cn: 提出分阶段交付并说明先交内容
tasks.hint_en: Can we split the delivery into two parts?
tasks.hint_cn: split into two parts，并说先交哪一块。

tasks.desc_cn: 确认双方接受的两个交付日期
tasks.hint_en: So we agree on both dates?
tasks.hint_cn: 谈判收尾要复述一遍日期。
